title: Kung Pao Tofu
description: Crispy tofu, zucchini and bell pepper tossed in a sweet-spicy Kung Pao sauce with peanuts.
steps: Pan-fry the tofu until crisp on most sides, then set aside.
Stir-fry the zucchini and pepper until just tender.
Whisk the sauce ingredients, return the tofu, toss to coat, and finish with peanuts.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste Kung Pao tofu

notes: Sambal oelek is easy to dial up or down — start with less if you are not sure how much heat you want.
